decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

(Reason.  In order to safeguard the visual amenity of the area and building in particular and to satisfy the requirements of policies ENV B1.1New Development and H6.4 Extensions and alterations)

Condition : 3 - The premises shall be used as an office or as ancillary storage in relation to the ground floor use and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class A, B or C of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 4 - The proposed extension is considered suitable as office accommodation, due to its location, its complementary appearance to the existing building and surrounding area, and the fact that it has its own independent access and is considered to comply with Unitary Development Plan Policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), E.1.2 (Locations for Business (B1) Use), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and E.1.1 (Location of New Employment Development).
description: Erection of an office at first floor level
